text_block_list.text:
The day of local idol Hokko Tarumae's solo 
event in Tomakomai has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Because as a local idol, this is 
the first time I've ever had such a 
massive solo event, so—

I am certain that Hokko Tarumae will be 
fine. Because the scenery waiting for her 
over there is a result she seized with her 
own hard work.
choice_data_list: Let's welcome everyone with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well then— I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Everyoooone~!! Thank you for comin' all 
the way to Tomakomai to see me—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so very much!!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! Amazing, incredible! This 
venue is truly packed to the brim...!)

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chaaaan!! We came to see youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Give it your all, Tarumae-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sing and dance a whole bunch 
today!! Make sure you all have a blast~!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

And so, Hokko Tarumae's solo event came to 
a wildly successful and safe 
conclusion...!

A few days after the event in Tomakomai. 
At Tracen Academy—

...That day, Hokko Tarumae and I reviewed 
our performance based on data sent over by 
the event organizers.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —The data doesn't lie, does it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The participant survey results... To think 
that visitors from outside Tomakomai City 
didn't even make up 10%—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...This event was a packed house and a 
success only because the people of 
Tomakomai were there... right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it hadn't been held in Tomakomai... If 
it had just been my own strength... 
surely—

...Indeed, it was only because so many 
people from Tomakomai came that we were 
able to fill the venue. But—

It was Hokko Tarumae's hard work that made 
the people of Tomakomai want to come to 
the venue and cheer her on.

Holding an event in Tomakomai City, 
drawing in many local citizens, and making 
it a success. The results point to a major 
truth. And that is—
choice_data_list:
You proved that you're Tomakomai's local 
idol.

You proved that you're Tomakomai's local 
idol.

text_block_list.text:
"Hokko Tarumae is Tomakomai's bona fide 
local idol, deeply loved and supported by 
the community."

A solid track record that allows one to 
say so with pride had been built.
choice_data_list:
So let's move forward to the "next step" 
with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry! I went and assumed the 
worst again...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Even though everyone was enjoying the 
event so much, I've gone and ruined it by 
acting like this, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have to look forward...! I need to have 
confidence as Tomakomai's local idol and 
spread my wings even further!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to rely solely on my own 
strength to bring even more people to 
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So please, tell me. Where is the next 
place I should go...!

Through this event, Hokko Tarumae took the 
next step forward as a local idol. If so, 
what she must accomplish next is 
inevitably—
choice_data_list:
Next, let's make your breakthrough as a 
dirt Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: As a dirt Umamusume—

The Gâ ¢ race, the Leopard Stakes. It is a 
stepping stone often used by up-and-coming 
dirt runners before challenging the major 
stages in the autumn and beyond.

And there, by proudly displaying Hokko 
Tarumae's true strength, she'll surge 
straight to the forefront of the dirt 
division...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The "Leopard Stakes"...! That is where my 
strength as a dirt Umamusume will be put 
to the test.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll show everyone in Tomakomai, and 
everyone who's about to get to know me."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: My radiance as a dirt Uma Musume...!

And so, Hokko Tarumae set her new sights 
on the Leopard Stakes—

"...A few days later. That news came far 
too suddenly."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Everyone! Thank you all so much for 
gathering here for me today!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"'We understand you have a major 
announcement regarding your future 
today—'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Yeah! Well, you see...——"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I, Smart Falcon, have decided to step 
away from racing for a while and take a 
nice, long break!’"

text_block_list.name: Murmurs of the Crowd
text_block_list.text: "(Murmur murmur murmur...!!)"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No way...――

Since Smart Falcon was suddenly holding a 
press conference, I watched it with Hokko 
Tarumae, and then came an unexpected 
announcement—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "T-That's basically reti—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I'm not retiring or anything like that!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...As I'm sure everyone knows, I didn't 
get the results I'd hoped for at this 
year's Dubai World Cup, which I was 
invited to."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...So I thought this might be a good 
opportunity to reevaluate my running a 
bit... and decided to take some time off."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So—it's not like I'm retiring! I'll keep 
giving it my absolute all in my Umadol 
activities outside of racing!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"‘We imagine the other dirt Umamusume are 
surprised by this announcement as well... 
Do you have any comments for them?’"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...I agree. As for me—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Good luck to all the dirt Umamusume! 
I'll be stepping away from races for a 
little while, but I'll alwaaays be 
cheering on your brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dirt racing will shine so much brighter— 
even without me around!!’"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...No. Now is not the time to grieve...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I need to shine brighter too...! 
Especially after Falco-san said all 
that...!

Smart Falcon's words had certainly ignited 
a new flame in Hokko Tarumae's eyes...!

With the Leopard Stakes ahead— Carrying 
the hopes of her predecessors in her 
heart, Hokko Tarumae sprang into 
action...!
